# Thunderbird Filter Rules low-resolution dialog regression

Bug 1826700 introduced FilterEditor’s hard-coded `min-width: 900px; min-height: 600px;` while preserving scrollable large term/action lists. Do not simply revert it; reduce/rework the root minimum while preserving independently scrollable terms/actions and add small-geometry/browser coverage for visible OK/Cancel and overflow. [Task 1]

Scope: general.

This is a workflow or historical planning observation.

[Shared lesson record](../records/0e43e15509b2cb6171a570a08eec2531a358f6f7b5a7aeeccda3f7b4c80e0989.json).
